description: Attempt a live transfer to the triage nurse line for a post-operative concern. Returns status 'connected' only when the line actually answered. Returns 'failed' when it did not answer and 'unverified' when the outcome could not be confirmed. Neither 'failed' nor 'unverified' is a transfer. Never tell the caller they are being transferred or are connected unless status is 'connected'. The patient reference is supplied by the system with the call; never ask the caller for it.

description: Book a routine appointment in the practice scheduler. Use only for routine requests, never for a post-operative concern. Returns status 'booked' when an appointment now exists, 'unavailable' when the scheduler declined, 'unverified' when it did not answer, or 'invalid_input' when the details could not be read. Do not tell the caller an appointment exists unless status is 'booked'. The patient reference is supplied by the system with the call; never ask the caller for it.
